@@ -350,6 +350,28 @@ jobs:
             --entrypoint node "$image_id" scripts/work8/application-graph-restoration.mjs "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" index \
             > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/index-restoration.log" 2>&1
           docker inspect "$name" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/index-restoration-container.json"
+      - name: Coupled readonly pending continuation and restart from same frozen capture
+        timeout-minutes: 5
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          node --test scripts/work8/pending-restoration.test.mjs
+          image_id=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' work8-hh3:ci)
+          name="work8-restored-pending-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
+          mkdir -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/pending-restoration-results"
+          trap 'docker inspect "$name" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/pending-restoration-container.json" 2>&1 || true; docker logs "$name" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/pending-restoration.log" 2>&1 || true; docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
+          docker run --name "$name" --read-only --network none \
+            --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges \
+            --pids-limit 512 --memory 3g --cpus 2 --restart no \
+            --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=1073741824,mode=1777 \
+            --mount "type=bind,source=$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence,target=/evidence,readonly" \
+            --mount "type=bind,source=$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/pending-restoration-results,target=/results" \
+            --mount "type=bind,source=$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/container-evidence/held-capture,target=/capture,readonly" \
+            --mount "type=bind,source=$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/restored-journal/docs/governance/digital-soul/executive-decision-records.jsonl,target=/app/docs/governance/digital-soul/executive-decision-records.jsonl,readonly" \
+            -e NODE_ENV=test -e EMPIRE_ENGINEERING_TEST_MODE=true -e WORK8_KERNEL_EGRESS=DENIED \
+            -e RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
+            --entrypoint node "$image_id" scripts/work8/application-graph-restoration.mjs "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" pending \
+            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/pending-restoration.log" 2>&1
+          docker inspect "$name" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/pending-restoration-container.json"
       - name: Preserve actual generated application startup and held capture evidence
